csv_scope_of_work: The City of Foster City ( City ) is seeking qualified consulting firms (Consultants) to submit Statements of Qualifications to perform planning services on development applications and long-range planning projects on an on-call basis. The City is requesting responses from persons or firms with expertise necessary to process development applications including architectural review, application of California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), and conformance with federal, state, and local regulations. The selected consultant may also facilitate, lead, or assist planning staff with long-range planning initiatives.
